entities.name: Chiral sulfonamide alcohol substrate
observations: Substrate contains a terminal primary 3-hydroxypropyl side chain and a neighboring stereocenter.

entities.name: Appel bromination of primary alcohol
observations: CBr4 and triphenylphosphine convert the terminal primary alcohol to the corresponding bromide.
The stereocenter adjacent to the sulfonamide is retained; apparent @/@@ changes can reflect SMILES CIP representation.
Reported yield is 84% at 22 °C for 12 hours in acetonitrile.

entities.name: 3-Bromopropyl sulfonamide product
observations: Product results from replacing terminal OH with Br.
